title: PEB Dairy Shed for Latifia Dairy, Kasur | Steel Mind Engineers
description: Steel Mind Engineers built a 22,000 sq ft PEB dairy shed for Latifia Dairy at Kasur: 17 ft high, 110 ft wide and 200 ft long, with airflow for cattle.
h1: PEB Dairy Shed for Latifia Dairy at Kasur: 22,000 Square Feet of Steel Cattle Housing
quickAnswer: Steel Mind Engineers Pvt. Ltd. built a pre-engineered dairy shed for Latifia Dairy at Kasur. The shed is 17 feet high, 110 feet wide and 200 feet long and covers 22,000 square feet.
alt: PEB dairy shed built by Steel Mind Engineers for Latifia Dairy at Kasur.

faq.q: How big is the Latifia Dairy shed?
faq.a: It covers 22,000 square feet, with a width of 110 feet and a length of 200 feet.

faq.q: Can the shed be extended as the herd grows?
faq.a: Yes. Bolted frames allow extra bays at the end.

blocks.text: A dairy shed has one main job in Pakistan's heat: keep animals in shade with moving air and a dry floor. Steel Mind Engineers designed this shed as a pre-engineered building, made the steel in Lahore and erected it at the Latifia Dairy site in Kasur.

A high roof lets hot air rise. An open ridge and open or louvered sides allow cross-flow of air. The frame spacing follows the feed alleys and stalls. A steel roof is quick to build, so the farm can start using the shed sooner.
Steel Mind Engineers designs dairy sheds around the animals' comfort and the farm's daily routine. Larger sheds and feed stores can be added later.
